_comment: Scene 11 (open the white cabinet). The MuJoCo 3-drawer cabinet, converted MJCF->USD by data/preprocess_assets.py (custom/cabinet/processed/white_cabinet.usd): a fix_base articulation with three prismatic slide joints top/middle/bottom_level (drawers pull out ~0.16m along the cabinet's local -Y). Already metric (~0.26x0.22x0.32m) so scale=1.0. rot = -90deg yaw about Z so a drawer opening faces the robot (-X). Actuators leave the drawers free (stiffness 0) with light damping so a pulled drawer stays open. Verify orientation (drawer reachable), z (base on table), and drawer visibility in the smoke render.
